title: Patience often arrives after mercy, not before it.
summary: The cooled body in this shabad is not self-manufactured. It appears after saint company is given in grace.
takeaway: Grace can create the interior climate where patience becomes possible.
lifeApplication: When patience feels impossible, ask whether you need mercy and better company before more effort.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy, saint company, and patience are arranged together here.
source.lifeApplication: Receive help instead of treating patience as solitary heroism.

evidence.coreClaim: Mercy, saint company, and patience are arranged together here.
evidence.turn: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company.
evidence.practicalImplication: When patience feels impossible, ask whether you need mercy and better company before more effort.
